race.comment: FIERY LASS (2) drops out of a BM65 after working home evenly over 1800m on heavy ground and has a win at around this distance, while the 3kg claim helps offset the big weight. SPOT THE AUSSIE (3) was only fair in that same BM65, yet his narrow second at this track the start prior reads well and he has already placed on synthetic. ARCHERS REIGN (11) has a good record over this track and trip, and his synthetic record keeps him firmly in calculations despite being beaten by SPOT THE AUSSIE recently. LAUNCHER (5) was below his best when resuming well short of a preferred trip. Will appreciate stretching out over further, though the wide alley makes it tricky.
